title: 第17章 我的娘子是灵女第18章 师姐做邻灵女心事
slug: 凡人修仙捡个仙子做老婆
content_zh:
苏珂带着周元走出录事殿，从腰间锦袋里取出了一艘灵舟。
“师姐不仅看起来有实力，也是真有实力。”
周元从女子那里了解过，这种灵舟极其昂贵，随便都要上千颗灵石。
对于散修而言，这无疑是一个天文数字，相信即便是灵宗弟子，也没几个有实力随便花上千灵石买个代步工具的。
外宗的亲传弟子，都这么富有吗？
还是说这位苏珂师姐有什么特殊身份？
嗯，应该是不简单的。
不然如何能代表山主和奎阆山，前来招收弟子。
他那未来的娘子也有灵舟，会是什么身份。
云下某山的亲传弟子？
苏珂带着周元凌空而起，离开了山谷。这艘灵舟不算大，只能容坐三人，速度极快，却非常平稳，坐在上面只觉周围山林飞速后退。
灵舟掠过茂密的林地，数十里后，冲进了一条云雾缭绕的峡谷。
云雾里罡风呼啸，灵舟开始剧烈晃动。
周元抓紧舟沿，环顾周围，只觉雾气浩瀚，仿佛置身在浩瀚的云海，无边无际，时有大风汹涌，卷起滔天大浪，让人心神惊惧。
“别慌，这只是护宗罡气，会识别我们的令牌，不会伤害我们。”
苏珂话音刚落，云海罡风骤然消散，只剩下如洗的碧空，还有那连绵起伏的群山、高耸入云的山峰，以及一座座隐于云海之中的悬空山。
那些悬空山，想必就是内宗了。
云雾如海，浩浩荡荡，隔出云上云下两个世界。
灵宗！
我来了！

周元眺望群山，只觉心潮澎湃。
一个月前，他还只是一个快要饿死的村民。一月之间，先是美妙艳遇，结缘仙子，又测验灵根，修炼灵诀，然后唤醒二爷，推演机缘，挖灵参，得传承。
如今，他更是横穿千里云雾山，拜进了传说中的灵宗。
虽然只是记名弟子，但他身怀大秘，必能乘风而起。
灵途飘茫，但未来可期。
“那是谁？”
入宗的广场上耸立着一座女子的雕像，足有百丈，高如山峰，灵光熠熠，映照天穹。非常的醒目。而且雕像好似玉石，莹润光泽，模样更是娇美动人，惹得群山之间无数身影驻足眺望。
周元一时竟然呆住了，那雕像怎么跟她未来娘子一模一样？
“安若曦，云上大衍峰的弟子。半年前击败了上一任灵子顾青安，夺得五峰第一，她是我们万相灵宗未来三年的灵女。”
“什么是灵女？”
“云下九山，每隔三年，会举办一次九山大比，竞争进入内宗的名额。云上五峰也是每隔三年举行一次大比，获胜者将获灵女或是灵子身份。地位尊贵，堪比云上长老，连云下山主见到都要行礼。”
云上弟子？
content_en:
Su Ke led Zhou Yuan out of the Recording Hall and took out a spirit boat from the brocade bag on his waist.
"Senior sister not only looks capable, she is also really capable."
Zhou Yuan learned from the woman that this kind of spirit boat was extremely expensive, costing thousands of spirit stones.
For casual cultivators, this is undoubtedly an astronomical figure. I believe that even among Ling Sect disciples, few have the strength to spend thousands of Ling Stones on a means of transportation.
Are all the direct disciples of the outer sect so wealthy?
Or does this Senior Sister Su Ke have some special identity?
Well, it should not be simple.
Otherwise, how could he come to recruit disciples on behalf of the mountain master and Kuilang Mountain.
His future wife also has a spirit boat, what will her identity be.
A direct disciple of a certain mountain under the cloud?
Su Ke took Zhou Yuan into the sky and left the valley. This spiritual boat was not big, and could only accommodate three people. It was extremely fast, but very stable. Sitting on it, one could feel the surrounding mountains and forests receding rapidly.
The spirit boat passed through the dense forest, and after dozens of miles, it rushed into a mist-shrouded canyon.
The strong wind roared in the clouds and mist, and the spirit boat began to shake violently.
Zhou Yuan held on to the edge of the boat and looked around. He felt that the mist was vast, as if he were in a vast sea of ​​clouds. It was boundless. From time to time, there were strong winds and huge waves, which made people feel frightened.
"Don't panic, this is just the Protector Qi. It will recognize our token and will not harm us."
As soon as Su Ke finished speaking, the sea of clouds and the strong wind suddenly dissipated, leaving only the clear blue sky, the rolling mountains, the towering peaks reaching into the clouds, and the suspended mountains hidden in the sea of clouds.
Those hanging mountains must be the inner sect.
The clouds and mist are as vast as the sea, separating the two worlds above and below the clouds.
Lingzong!
I am coming!
Zhou Yuan looked at the mountains and felt his heart surge.
A month ago, he was just a villager who was about to starve to death. In one month, he first had a wonderful encounter, got to know a fairy, then tested his spiritual roots, practiced spiritual techniques, and then awakened the second master to deduce the opportunities, dig up spiritual ginseng, and obtain the inheritance.
Now, he has traveled across thousands of miles of Yunwu Mountain to worship the legendary Ling Sect.
Although he is only a named disciple, he possesses great secrets and will surely be able to ride on the wind.
The spiritual path is uncertain, but the future is promising.
"Who is that?"
In the square where he entered the sect, there stood a statue of a woman, which was a hundred feet tall and as high as a mountain peak. Its aura shone brightly and reflected the sky. Very eye-catching. Moreover, the statue is like jade, shiny and beautiful, and its appearance is even more charming, causing countless figures to stop and look at it in the mountains.
Zhou Yuan was stunned for a moment. How come the statue looked exactly like his future wife?
"An Ruoxi, a disciple of Yunshang Dayan Peak. She defeated the previous spirit son Gu Qing'an half a year ago and won the first place in the five peaks. She will be the spirit daughter of our Wanxiang Spirit Sect for the next three years."
"What is a spirit girl?"
"Yunxiajiu Mountain, every three years, will hold a nine-mountain competition to compete for places to enter the inner sect. Yunxiao Mountain's five peaks will also hold a competition every three years, and the winner will be awarded the status of spirit daughter or spirit son. The status is noble, comparable to the Yunshang elders, even the Yunxia Mountain master will salute when he sees it."
Disciple on the cloud?
